CC.E-1.REPORT. Lucky T Appeal
CC.E-1.REPORT.Lucky T Appeal. ATTACHMENTS
Solis moved to call for the question. ; seconded by 0.
The motion failed by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, and Vince House. NOES: Argudo, Holloway, and Mendoza.
Solis moved to deny the appeal, find the decision of City Staff to not accept the business license application was proper and uphold the decision, and prepare a resolution with the appropriate findings. ; seconded by Holloway.
The motion carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Holloway, Solis, and Mendoza. NOES: Argudo, and Vince House.
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE YOUTH ACTIVITIES GRANT PROGRAM GUIDELINES (Requested by Council Members John Solis and Dan Holloway)
CC.E-2.REPORT.Youth Activities Grant Program Guidelines Amendment
Holloway moved to amend the Youth Activities Grant Program Guidelines by: 1) including language that defines that grants for La Puente resident youth only for activities (including leagues/teams) within the City of La Puente only, 2) ensure that all activities are within the City limits, and 3) include language that references the La Puente All American Football and Cheer and La Puente ASA Girls Softball, and removes all former names. ; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Argudo, Holloway, Solis, Mendoza, and Vince House. NOES: None.
RECONVENE THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION MEETING

The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Argudo, Holloway, Solis, Mendoza, and Vince House. NOES: None.
